purpose: Not a fixed weekly plan. Given sets logged this week vs weekly target floors, recommend the next session and show balance. Weekly-grain checklist logic (Good Weeks), exercise content from Chet's Nippard-based plan, recovery/cardio framing from Huberman, peptide/enhancement lens noted from Bakri (no dosing).

weekly_target_floors_sets._note: Floors, not ceilings. Chest is capped, not encouraged: never more than 3 chest sets in one session and never recommend chest when he skips it. Targets cover one Upper + one Legs session as minimum viable week.

constraints.progression: bump weight or reps off last logged session for that lift; no easing in, he asked for full intensity
constraints.logging: sets arrive as texts; hub auto-fills the checklist from the lift log, he never taps to log
constraints.ratings: optional 1-10 how-it-went per session, settable by the agent (Good Weeks mechanic)

recommendation_logic: 1. Tally this week's sets per muscle_group from the lift log (map each logged exercise to a group; custom exercises get tagged at creation).
2. Compute deficit per group = floor minus logged. Priority weight: legs > back > shoulders > arms > core > chest (his stated bring-up order; chest last and capped).

3. Recovery filter: do not recommend a session whose main groups were trained in the last ~48h. (Judgment, standard hypertrophy practice; both Nippard-style plans and the Huberman foundational protocol hit each muscle about twice a week.)
4. Pick the template covering the largest weighted deficit. If both upper templates qualify, recommend the one not done most recently (A/B alternation).
5. If all lift floors are met, recommend aerobic: speed-track if none this week, else zone2. One speed session per week max.
6. Chest rule: include the chest exercise only if chest floor unmet; if he declines chest, drop it without re-nudging.
7. Output format for the Today card: session label, exercise list with last-weight prefill, and a Left this week line (remaining sets per group). Neglected groups render amber.
8. After the session's sets are logged, prompt optional 1-10 rating (Good Weeks).
9. Never prescribe makeup volume for missed weeks; floors reset fresh each Monday. (Rotation-floor rule from the Sep 22 framework.)

rotation_floor.rule: 2 lifts + 2 short aerobic sessions per week; nothing hard after call or under 6h sleep; never make up missed volume
rotation_floor.source: Sep 22 hybrid framework, built for rotations

daily_checkpoints.item: Fixed wake time, 7+ h sleep opportunity

enhancement_note.bakri_lane: Bakri's published content is peptides/GLP-1/TRT, not training programming (he was Huberman's podcast guest on peptides). Sourced position: most peptides have minimal or no human studies. Chet's compounds (MOTS-c, bromantane) are his decided call; the plan tracks but does not dose or argue.
